title: The Shadow of the Gods
author: John Gwynne
summary: Generations after the gods fought and fell, a Norse-flavoured land is scarred by their remains. Three people from very different backgrounds are pulled into a hunt for a mythic legacy as old powers return.
readIf: you like big, bloody fantasy with warriors, monsters and a pantheon of dead gods.
skipIf: you want a gentle read or are put off by long fight scenes.

pairings.reason: Similarly brutal and character-driven, with a sharper sense of humour and more political scheming.
The author's earlier series, a more traditional fantasy with the same love of battle and mythology.
A comparable multi-viewpoint epic where violence has real consequences for anyone.
